checks.name: external_workspace_start_and_stop
checks.detail: Added the three separate fixture documents, observed neutral enabled Start and secondary actions, started the workspace, then exited with Control+Option+Escape. The manager reported original positions and sizes restored. The UI tool selected the backdrop window during workspace capture, so this does not establish rail/edge compositor appearance.

limitations: Diagnostic flags exercise local branches and do not establish real OS preference switching or older macOS fallback.
Snapshots are visual review only; no numerical contrast audit or exhaustive arbitrary-wallpaper assessment.
The workspace screenshot tool selected the backdrop; full rail and edge compositor appearance was not visually verified in this revision.
System focus rings, native control accents, screen-capture privacy indicator and original application icons retain OS/user colors.
